name: Couriers' Association
content: You say 'riders will use road lanes'—where are the protected lanes NOW? 40km in 2 years won't work when fines start June 1. We weren't even consulted. Our members can't risk traffic without protection. Protected lanes FIRST. We need a meeting. Today.

name: Quick-Bite
content: Safety is paramount. We're committed to supporting this initiative and working with city partners on a smooth transition for our riders. We're reviewing operational solutions to ensure our delivery partners are supported throughout.

name: Marco (rider)
content: so 40km in 2 years but lanes are zero today? where do i ride tomorrow? city never actually rides these routes
